summary_1line: Dhritarashtra, Gandhari, and Kunti retire to the forest, begin ascetic life under sages, and Dhritarashtra receives initiation into forest-dweller vows.

image_candidates.scene_text: On the bank of the Bhagirathi at sunset, Dhritarashtra pours libations into a blazing sacrificial fire while sages chant around him.
Kunti gently leads the blind Dhritarashtra and veiled Gandhari out of the sacred river after their ritual bath.
In a forest hermitage, the aged Dhritarashtra stands thin and austere in bark garments and matted locks, surrounded by ascetics and sacred fires.
